about: Named trips priced by the live check (pnpm --filter @repo/db price:check) and offered as Try a trip's examples on each location's Rates tab. Each end is a Google place id, or a pin for a spot with no place. expected is the total in sen, or the refusal's code; null prints the price without checking it. Add a row whenever a price is questioned. See docs/261023-nearest-zone-pricing.md, Testing.

trips.name: Airport to Orange
trips.note: RM51.94 on the demo's roads: the Pantai Kok cell plus about 0.77 km of extra road.

trips.name: Orange to Airport
trips.note: The same as Airport to Orange, read the other way.

trips.name: Airport to Blue
trips.note: Blue is reached before the Datai zone, so it pays the plain Airport to Datai cell.

trips.name: Orange to Blue
trips.note: Needs the Pantai Kok to Datai cell, empty until Ops fills it.

trips.name: Kuah Town to Kuah Town
trips.note: Needs Kuah Town's within-zone cell, empty until Ops fills it.

trips.name: Airport to Mak Ngah Kotiaw
trips.note: Nearest in a straight line is Datai, by road Tanjung Rhu. RM92.38 with the whole extra road, RM88.78 with the proposed cap.

trips.name: Kuah Town to Homestay Mahsuri
trips.note: A near tie: Kuah Town's edge is 5.73 km by road, the Airport's 5.75 km.
